nodes.label: mongodb Compose Service
nodes.rationale: mongo:7.0 as jobocate-mongodb on 27017 with MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE=jobocate, a named mongodb_data volume for persistence, and a mongosh ping healthcheck (10s interval) that the backend gates on via depends_on: condition: service_healthy.

nodes.label: backend Compose Service
nodes.rationale: Built from backend/Dockerfile with root context, published on 8000, env from backend/.env.docker with AI/OAuth keys overridden from the host shell. Sets INTERNAL_FRONTEND_URL=http://frontend:3000 so Puppeteer reaches the frontend over the compose network rather than localhost. Anonymous volume masks /app/node_modules; backend-uploads persists resume files. Waits for mongodb to be healthy; HTTP healthcheck hits /health.

nodes.label: frontend Compose Service
nodes.rationale: Next.js dev server on 3000 with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL pointed at localhost:8000 (browser-side), WATCHPACK_POLLING=true so file watching works across the bind mount on macOS/Windows, and anonymous volumes shielding node_modules and .next.

nodes.label: INTERNAL_FRONTEND_URL Puppeteer Networking
nodes.rationale: Puppeteer runs inside the backend container, where 'localhost:3000' is the backend itself, not the frontend. INTERNAL_FRONTEND_URL=http://frontend:3000 resolves the frontend by compose service name so PDF generation can load /resume/preview/:id — distinct from the browser-facing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL which must use localhost.

nodes.label: jobocate-network Bridge Network
nodes.rationale: Bridge network joining mongodb, backend and frontend, enabling service-name DNS resolution between containers.
